high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from the verified Twitter account @Variety. The tweet announces the premiere details for Gary Oldman's "Slow Horses" Season 5, which will be available on Apple TV+ starting September 24. The tweet specifies that the season will premiere with two episodes on its launch date, followed by one episode weekly until the finale on October 22. The tweet includes a link to a first-look video, which can be accessed at wp.me/pc8uak-1IFSnb. Below the tweet, there are four still images from the show, each depicting different scenes:
